orgName: British Champions Day (British Champions Series Ltd)

source.name: British Champions Day - QATAR RACING TO BECOME TITLE SPONSOR OF BRITISH CHAMPIONS DAY
source.note: 'QATAR RACING will succeed its parent company, QIPCO, as title sponsor of British Champions Day... the headline sponsorship switch to become Qatar Racing British Champions Day including individual sponsorship of all seven races'; Sheikh Fahad: 'the title sponsorship will transfer to Qatar Racing for the next three years'. Day worth GBP 4.35m.

note: Three-year deal (2026-2028) covering the meeting and all seven races: Qatar Racing Champion Stakes, Queen Elizabeth II Stakes (Sponsored by Qatar Racing), British Champions Fillies & Mares Stakes, Long Distance Cup, Sprint Stakes, 2YO Conditions Stakes and Balmoral Handicap (Sponsored by Qatar Racing). Fee not published.
